Scope: sports grounds (padel, basketball and football), a service and toilet building, landscape works, bike and walking paths, and parking at three sites in Asir, Jazan and Jeddah.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. The project is at 42.4% against 51.0% planned, 8.6% behind (SPI 0.83). It gained 3.4% this week against 4.1% planned, so the gap widened from 8.0% last week. Jazan is furthest behind at 24.3% against 44.5% planned; Jeddah is ahead of its plan.

Project completion is forecast 104 days late. The weekly report and the P6 update (data date 19-Oct-2026) both forecast completion on 09-May-2027, against the contract completion date of 25-Jan-2027. P6 shows −85 days of float on project completion and 330 open activities with negative float. The most critical path runs through the steel tension cables and the PVC membrane approval (−85 days), and supply of the air dome is the challenge named in the weekly summary. The original baseline called for 75.1% by mid-October.

Work done this weekGround slab cast for the football and basketball courts in Asir. Air dome foundations cast, with glazed-façade steelwork under way, at all sites. Irrigation pipes finished in Asir and Jeddah, and curbs around the courts finished in Jeddah. Stone cladding finished on the Asir toilets. Water-tank tie beam cast in Jazan. Toilet ceramics, roof insulation, lighting cables and pole foundations, and walkway backfilling continue.

Landscaping and tree supply have not started. Against the plan to date, sewer and drainage pipe is at 55 of 177 LM and 150 mm uPVC pipe at 50 of 150 LM.

MV cables on the excavation routeOwnerRaised 10-Oct-2026 (Jazan, per the risk and issue log). Medium-voltage cables conflict with the excavation route; coordination with the relevant parties on mitigation is ongoing and the contractor is waiting for the owner's permission.
Air dome supplyContractorNamed as the project challenge in the weekly summary. The risk register rates delay in air-dome material delivery High (score 20); mitigation is close follow-up with MODON to speed up approval of the air dome design, target 15-Nov-2026.

The risk register has 9 open risks. Six are rated High: air-dome delivery delay, air quality in confined spaces, equipment maintenance and certification, fall protection, heat stress, and separation of public traffic. Two are Medium (unauthorised site entry, unsafe material storage) and one is Low (defective tools). The seven earlier issues in the issue log are closed.

Data notes

  • Only the latest weekly upload (W3, data date 19-Oct-2026) was used. "This week" values come from the report's own last-week columns; the quantity table has none, so its this-week column is blank.
  • The report week is the project week counted from site handover (26-Mar-2026 to 19-Oct-2026 is 207 days, week 29). The files carry the serial WPR-25 but state no week number.
  • The weekly summary sheets (files 15 and 16) and the Conclusion sheet give 35.39% actual against 39.13% planned. These are cost-based (earned value) figures; this report uses physical progress, 42.41% against 51.03%.
  • File 16 names a different contractor (شركة الانجاز للتجارة والمقاولات), project manager (عبد الله الشنيفي), sector (القطاع الأوسط), start date 24-Nov-2025 and contract end 23-May-2026. File 15 and the weekly report give Profast, Eng. Yazeed Al Ragabh, 26-Mar-2026 and 25-Jan-2027.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet puts the revised plan at 57.8% for mid-October, above the 51.0% planned to 19-Oct in the Progress sheet. The baseline curve totals 427,120 man-hours against 406,255 in the revised plan and the Progress sheet.
  • The earned-value "original plan" to date is 10.5% in the Progress sheet, while the EV chart's baseline reaches 78.6% by mid-October.
  • The Milestones sheet's baseline dates for programme approval (02-Jun-2026), mobilisation (25-Jan-2027) and testing and commissioning (29-Apr-2026) look shifted; the summary on the report's first sheet gives 29-Apr and 02-Jun for the first two. The Conclusion sheet dates project end as 25-Jan-2026 and playground completion as 16-Jan-2026.
  • The major-quantity panel on the report's first sheet has shifted columns (for example, trees: 895 total, 30,380 remaining), so quantities were taken from the Major Quantities sheet.
  • The invoice log counts 47 consultant-approved invoices although only 5 were submitted.
  • The HSE statistics sheet covers 06–13 Oct 2026 and gives 137,270 cumulative man-hours and 159 toolbox talks; the report summary gives 132,050 and 156.
  • The procurement log shows street lighting poles as delivered to site, while the supply file shows 0 of 322 delivered. In the supply file the remarks and unit columns look shifted for several rows.
  • Several cells on the report's first sheet show #REF! errors (EAC and the milestone panel).
